rows.label: Hamlet
rows.creator: William Shakespeare
rows.hook: follows a Danish prince who feigns madness while seeking revenge for his father's murder

rows.label: Romeo and Juliet
rows.creator: William Shakespeare
rows.hook: tells of two teenagers from feuding families in Verona whose love ends in tragedy

rows.label: Macbeth
rows.creator: William Shakespeare
rows.description: tragic play by William Shakespeare from the early 1600s
rows.hook: follows a Scottish nobleman driven to murder his way to the throne after witches' prophecy

rows.label: Death of a Salesman
rows.creator: Arthur Miller
rows.hook: follows Willy Loman, a worn-out traveling seller chasing the American Dream

rows.label: Othello
rows.creator: William Shakespeare
rows.hook: centers on a Moorish general whose jealousy is stoked by his scheming ensign Iago

rows.label: The Crucible
rows.creator: Arthur Miller
rows.hook: dramatizes the Salem witch trials as an allegory for McCarthyism

rows.label: King Lear
rows.creator: William Shakespeare
rows.hook: follows an aging monarch who divides his kingdom among his three daughters and slides into madness

rows.label: Wicked
rows.creator: Stephen Schwartz
rows.description: 2003 musical based on the 1995 Gregory Maguire's novel
rows.hook: tells the untold story of the witches of Oz before Dorothy arrives

rows.label: Faust
rows.creator: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
rows.description: play by Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
rows.hook: is a German two-part verse drama about a restless scholar who wagers with the devil Mephistopheles

rows.label: The Tragical History of Doctor Faustus
rows.creator: Christopher Marlowe
rows.hook: stages an Elizabethan academic trading his soul to Lucifer for twenty-four years of magical power

rows.label: Julius Caesar
rows.creator: William Shakespeare
rows.hook: shows Roman senators led by Brutus plotting to stab their ruler on the Ides of March

rows.label: Antony and Cleopatra
rows.creator: William Shakespeare
rows.hook: depicts the doomed romance between a Roman general and the queen of Egypt

rows.label: Hedda Gabler
rows.creator: Henrik Ibsen
rows.description: play in four acts by Norwegian plawright Henrik Ibsen, published in 1890
rows.hook: follows a restless newlywed, a general's daughter, who manipulates those around her
